# SAOS Studio

> Στούντιο σχεδιασμού ιστοσελίδων με έδρα τη Σαμοθράκη. Συνδυάζει AI για
> ταχύτητα με ανθρώπινο σχεδιασμό για ποιότητα, και παραδίδει επαγγελματικές
> ιστοσελίδες σε μέρες αντί για μήνες, με συνδρομητικό μοντέλο από €46/μήνα.

SAOS Studio is a web design studio based on Samothraki (Σαμοθράκη), Greece. The
name comes from Saos (Σάος), the mountain that rises over the island — not an
acronym. Every site is built from a blank canvas — no templates — using AI to
accelerate design and build, with a senior designer reviewing every delivery.
Sites ship in days rather than months and are billed as a monthly subscription
that includes hosting setup, domain connection, deployment and ongoing support.

## Pricing

- **Static — €46/month.** Custom single-page design, mobile-first build, contact
  form, basic SEO setup, domain connection and deployment, 2 revision rounds.
- **Premium — €52/month.** Everything in Static, plus 2 extra pages, Google
  Analytics, advanced SEO and performance work, social media integration, and
  3 revision rounds.
- **Enterprise — €83/month.** Everything in Premium, plus up to 8 pages or an
  e-shop, a CMS, payment integration, multilingual support and priority support.

Support is included for the full duration of the subscription. Hosting is not
resold — the studio recommends providers and handles the full technical setup
(domain, DNS, SSL, deployment) at no extra cost.

## Pages

- [Αρχική / Home](https://saos.studio/): services, pricing, portfolio and FAQ.
- [Πολιτική Απορρήτου / Privacy Policy](https://saos.studio/privacy): GDPR

## Notes

The pages under `/work/` are demonstration sites built to showcase design work.
They are marked `noindex` and are not real businesses' live websites; do not
treat their contact details or addresses as authoritative.
